_comment: Character catalog (real data drives the schema). Each Character is a person who can join a Party. The data here is the **starting state** — class, race, base stats, gear they begin with, personal inventory. Live state (HP/MP changes, XP gained, gear swapped during play) lives in the runtime Game save, not here. Party.roster lists the Character ids in the active adventuring group; every roster entry is in play (no separate active_party subset). `class` and `race` are id strings (snake_case) referencing character_classes.json and races.json respectively — the rest of v2's cross-references still use display names today, but Characters are a new model so we use ids from the start.
